thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: rate-limiter-service (prod-us-east) returning elevated 429s across multiple tenants. PD-INC-8421. Automated anomaly detector flagged sudden jump at 08:02 UTC.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page -> oncall@redwood-sre (alice) // escalate in 5m if unack'd.

alice: acked. I'm on it. Pulling logs + dashboard.

ben: I'm nearby, ping me if you want handoff.

alice: quick summary: traffic normal but 429s spike from limiter replicas in us-east-1. Not global yet. Initial rate: ~0.3% -> 12% in 90s.

sam: any deploys or config pushes in last 10m?

alice: checking deploys... none in last 30m according to deploy-bot. Could be config rollout from quota-mapper service.

priya: support: multiple customers reporting throttled API calls (noticed at ~08:04). Customer C and D have live traffic. Escalating to CS.

marta: notified CS leads, prepping customer-impact comms.

alice: running quick queries:
```sql
-- count 429s recent
select count(*) as c, bin(time, 1m) as minute from api_requests where status = 429 and region = 'us-east-1' and time > now() - 15m group by minute order by minute desc limit 10;
```

alice: result shows sharp spike starting at 08:01 UTC, concentrated on limiter-instance group "limiter-rt-6" and "limiter-rt-7".

sam: can you tail the logs for limiter-rt-6?

alice: tailing now:
```
2026-03-14T08:01:12Z limiter-rt-6 ERROR rate_limiter.go:429 applied-quota-mapper: missing-mapper for tenant=acct-73
2026-03-14T08:01:12Z limiter-rt-6 WARN rate_limiter.go:512 fallback-to-default: token-bucket-depleted tenant=acct-73
2026-03-14T08:01:14Z limiter-rt-7 ERROR rate_limiter.go:429 quota-map-not-found tenant=acct-21
```

alice: looks like quota-mapper service returned empty mapping for many tenants, causing limiter to apply strict default caps -> 429s.

ben: aha — quota-mapper had a cache invalidation bug last week in canary, maybe the same path triggered by an evict storm. Any metrics from quota-mapper?

alice: quota-mapper metrics show sudden 503s and increased latency around 08:00:57 UTC from the same region.

sam: I can flip limiter fallback policy to be lenient (allow higher default) while we restore mapper. That will reduce 429s but increase cost/risk. Recommend short window.

priya: customer impact: customers A, C, D reporting errors in production; A is high-revenue. Need comms if we expect >10m.

alice: mitigation plan: 1) flip limiter fallback to permissive for us-east for 10m 2) restart quota-mapper pod pool in us-east 3) increase mapper cache TTL temporarily 4) monitor 429 rate and customer reports.

ben: agree. I'll take restart + cache-TTL. Sam, can you apply fallback change?

sam: applying fallback change now via runtime feature-flag: `ffctl set limiter.fallback.permissive true --scope=us-east --ttl=600`

sam: command output:
```
$ ffctl set limiter.fallback.permissive true --scope=us-east --ttl=600
ok: flag set on 3 services (limiter-rt-4, limiter-rt-6, limiter-rt-7)
```

alice: seeing 429 drop immediately from ~12% -> ~1.5% over 90s. Good.

ben: restarting quota-mapper pods (rolling) in us-east now: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/quota-mapper --selector=region=us-east`

ben: restart in progress, will watch readiness.

marta: copying planned comms draft to legal + cs channel. Short note: "We're investigating transient rate-limiting events in us-east; mitigation in progress."

priya: will flag customers A/C/D and offer status updates every 15m.

alice: quota-mapper pods back, health=green at 08:18 UTC. Metrics show mapper lookup error rate back to baseline.

sam: rolling back permissive flag in 2m to confirm stability.

alice: 429s continue to fall to baseline (~0.2%). Good sign.

sam: rolling flag back now: `ffctl set limiter.fallback.permissive false --scope=us-east`

sam: flag removed. Observability: no regression, 429s steady.

ben: analysis so far: root cause = transient quota-mapper cache eviction leading to blank mappings -> limiter applied strict defaults. Contributing factor = low mapper retry/backoff under load.

alice: action items: 
- ben: open PR to increase mapper retry/backoff + add circuit-breaker (owner: ben)
- sam: add an automated runbook step to flip fallback for region in alerting playbook (owner: sam)
- priya/marta: customer comms follow-ups (owners: priya/marta)
- alice: write incident summary and severity determination (owner: alice)

ben: assigned. I'll include telemetry changes and add a metric for 'mapper-empty-lookup-rate' to trigger earlier alerts.

priya: CS will send one-off update to affected accounts now.

marta: raised support ticket: CS-5049 with account ids + sample logs.

alice: handing off to ben for postmortem and code fixes. I'm going to sleep (oncall handoff). Leaving the channel. :wave:

ben: taking over. I'll coordinate postmortem and link to docs. Closing PD incident.

pagerduty: Incident PD-INC-8421 resolved by alice, closed by ben at 08:48 UTC.

ben: postmortem checklist created: https://redwood.internal/pm/postmortems/PD-8421 (placeholder). Will include timelines, root cause, rollbacks, and detection improvements.

marta: thanks team.

priya: thanks, closing customer loop after PM summary.

incident-bot: Note: automated mitigation (fallback flip) used. Add entry to runbook about using feature-flag in emergencies.

ben: will do. Closing thread.
